name: Hoi An lantern night
summary: On the 14th night of each lunar month the ancient town gives up electric light for candles and lanterns. The July 2025 notice places the contact point at Quảng trường Sông Hoài, 01 Cao Hồng Lãnh. Local groups keep music, đường poetry, chess, martial arts, tuồng, bài chòi, and folk singing. That notice does not sell a ticket for the night. The Gregorian date and the hour are check on arrival.
when: The 14th night of each lunar month. The hour is check on arrival.
